mapper.select: select 'article' as ref_type, count(*) as ref_count from blog_article where del_flag = '0' and (cover_url like concat('%', #{url}, '%') or content like concat('%', #{url}, '%') or content_md like concat('%', #{url}, '%')) union all select 'page' as ref_type, count(*) as ref_count from blog_page where del_flag = 0 and content like concat('%', #{url}, '%') union all select 'setting' as ref_type, count(*) as ref_count from blog_setting where config_value like concat('%', #{url}, '%') union all select 'friendLink' as ref_type, count(*) as ref_count from blog_friend_link where del_flag = 0 and logo like concat('%', #{url}, '%') union all select 'userAvatar' as ref_type, count(*) as ref_count from sys_user where del_flag = '0' and avatar like concat('%', #{url}, '%')
